name: Votive Hauberk
flavour: Faith is cheap when every wound is a candle.
note: A power charge from every critical strike on a huge armour and energy shield chainmail, paid for with half your mana. The keystone-style spell rider on the later version is dropped.
drop: Gain a Power Charge for each Enemy you hit with a Critical Strike

name: Drillmaster Boots
flavour: Keep step, and the banners keep up.
note: Plus two to socketed aura gems on massive armour and energy shield boots with elemental resistances and speed. The socketed support that reflects an aura onto allies is dropped.

name: Wellspring Slippers
flavour: Drink deep, and let the body go dry.
note: A big mana pool, power charges on critical strikes and cheaper reservation on fast boots, with life regeneration reduced to nothing. The stun threshold swap and the displayed base energy shield line are dropped.

name: Hexhold Greaves
flavour: More than one grudge fits on a heavy boot.
note: Armour, elemental resistances, speed and elemental damage, with room for one more hex on an enemy.

name: Bellmetal Greaves
flavour: Struck once, they ring across the field.
note: Huge armour, elemental resistances, speed and elemental damage, with one more hex per enemy and wider curse areas.
drop: Area of Effect of Curse Skills

name: Heronwing
flavour: Two shafts leave for every one that was drawn.
note: Two additional arrows with big added physical damage, critical multiplier and evasion on a bow. The eight-second reflex cycle (close-range bonus and the speed bonus outside it) is dropped.

name: Bloodtithe Claw
flavour: It takes its due from the ones it cuts.
note: Life per hit, physical damage and life leech on a claw. The abyssal warcry trigger and the warcry effect and cooldown lines are dropped.

name: Fleetfang
flavour: Built for the one who never stands still.
note: Strength, dexterity, attack speed and life per hit on a claw, with more damage and attack speed on movement skills.

name: Witherpalm Gloves
flavour: A touch that goes on working after you let go.
note: Grants a level 22 withering skill, with damage over time, energy shield and area of effect. Hinder lines are dropped (Bob has no hinder).

name: Velvet Hold
flavour: A soft grip that never lets the leash go slack.
note: Intelligence, life and mana, with slowing hexes on hit. The corpse-based curse lines are dropped.

name: Slingstone Gauntlets
flavour: Small hands, long reach, one good throw.
note: Strength, armour and added physical to attacks, with Strength's damage bonus applying to projectile attacks (Strongarm).

name: Quicksilk Gloves
flavour: The words arrive before the breath does.
note: Socketed spells are supported by Faster Casting, with intelligence, energy shield and life. The mana-spent critical chance burst is dropped.

name: Fickle Fists
flavour: Quick with everything but good sense.
note: Attack speed and cast speed at a mana cost, plus a chance on kill for each of the three charge kinds. The charge-sharing keystone is dropped.
drop: 10% chance to gain a Frenzy, Power or Endurance Charge on Kill

name: Spotter Gloves
flavour: Point it out once and it stays pointed out.
note: Accuracy, life, spell dodge and a chaos penalty, and a hit calls down the ruin mark on the enemy (a granted trigger stands in for the on-hit curse). The critical chance per accuracy line is dropped.

name: Hairshirt Gloves
flavour: Strength spent on the wrong kind of prayer.
note: Armour and energy shield, with Strength's damage bonus applying to spells at a spell damage penalty (written as spell damage per five strength). The attribute requirement penalty is dropped.

name: Hexweaver Gloves
flavour: One curse never satisfied her, so she wove another.
note: Casting a curse also fires the socketed curse spells, with one more hex per enemy, faster curses and energy shield. The leech per curse line is dropped.
drop: You can apply an additional Curse

name: Narrowing Gauntlets
flavour: Everything it holds is pulled tighter.
note: Socketed gems are supported by Concentrated Effect, with armour, evasion and life, and cheaper skills per endurance charge. The rampage lines are dropped.
drop: Lose all Endurance Charges when Rampage ends

name: Rallymaster Helm
flavour: The pack hears it and forgets the cold.
note: Plus two to socketed aura gems with evasion, cold resistance, chill and freeze protection and cheaper reservation.

name: Cursecaller Circlet
flavour: Spite, polished until it shines.
note: Plus two to socketed curse gems, energy shield, intelligence and elemental damage. The curse duration and damage per curse lines are dropped.

name: Umbral Circlet
flavour: What the elements leave behind, it keeps.
note: Elemental damage gained as extra chaos with energy shield, mana and stun recovery. The triggered on-skill gaze is dropped.

name: Flux Hood
flavour: Hot and cold are only two ways of saying change.
note: Evasion, huge mana regeneration and fire and cold resistance. The cross-element recent-skill damage lines are dropped.
drop: Cold Damage if you have used a Fire Skill Recently
Fire Damage if you have used a Cold Skill Recently
